recipe.notes: Not applicable to Memory QA: the local backend has no embedder, no extraction pipeline and no ranked read. The only model role is the agent model, chosen by the Cat 40 cell (newest Opus, GPT, Sonnet and Fable per CLAUDE.md).

common.notes: Letta has no extraction or embedding step to set; the common-models arm does not apply.

time_notes: Messages and memory commits carry wall-clock times; there is no way to backdate a session to its event_time.

provenance.mechanism: No passive retrieval returns items. The local archival-memory and passages endpoints in the bundled letta-client exist only for Letta Cloud; LocalBackend implements agents, conversations, messages, runs and memory files only.

delete_notes: For the passive contract. Memory files can be deleted with the App Server's delete_memory_file command, but there is no passive ingest to delete from.
readiness: not applicable (no passive ingest). The App Server is ready when it answers app_server_info with backend local; /health reports that handshake.
namespace: agent (a native driver would create one local agent per task or namespace with create_agent)

agent_surface.version: Letta Code 0.34.4 App Server, protocol_version 1, `letta server --listen ws://0.0.0.0:4500 --ws-auth capability-token --backend local`
agent_surface.notes: Verified on 2026-10-05: app_server_info returns backend local and capabilities agent_management, conversation_management, memory_management, runtime_start; metered headless turns reached OpenAI and Anthropic only through the proxy.

spike_findings: letta/letta:0.34.4 is Letta Code 0.34.4 (Node CLI and App Server), not the retired Python API server; its entrypoint refuses the old server's settings.
Local backend storage is files under ~/.letta/lc-local-backend: JSONL transcripts plus a git-backed memory filesystem (memfs) per agent.
No archival memory on the local backend: the bundled letta-client's /v1/agents/{id}/archival-memory and /v1/passages/search are Cloud API routes that LocalBackend does not implement.

Every message write is an agent turn: HeadlessBackend.executeConversationTurn appends the input and runs the model executor. Metered on 2026-10-05, a one-line prompt sent 22,020 input tokens to gpt-4.1-mini and 26,122 to claude-haiku-4-5, almost all of it Letta's system prompt.

`letta messages search` is the only passive read: keyword (FTS) search over raw transcripts on the local backend (vector and hybrid modes throw), returning whole messages including Letta's injected system reminders, dated by wall clock.

The App Server exposes passive memory-file commands (write_memory_file, read_memory_file, list_memory, delete_memory_file). They store Markdown files under git with validation hooks (each directory needs a MEMORY.md index; per-file size limits) but offer no query-ranked read; the agent decides what to load.

Providers: `letta connect openai-compatible --base-url <proxy>/openai/v1` and `letta connect anthropic --api-key <dummy> --base-url <proxy>/anthropic` both route through the metering proxy (verified metered). ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL alone is ignored: the model catalog hardcodes https://api.anthropic.com, so without --base-url the call has no route and fails. Letta asks Anthropic for 64,000 output tokens per turn, above the proxy's default 32,768 cap, so a Cat 40 cell must lower Letta's output limit or raise the proxy cap, and the per-turn reservation scales with that limit.
deviations_from_vendor_code: No Letta Code benchmark ingestion code exists at v0.34.4 (AMB at f618ed7 has no Letta provider), so there is nothing to start from.
